title: Cleansing the Sunjiang District

{{HMQuest}} {{ Quest infobox | id = 1350 | name = Cleansing the Sunjiang District | section = Kaineng City | given by = [[Initiate Zei Ri]] | given at = [[Kaineng Center]] | region = Kaineng City | campaign = Winds of Change | preceded by = [[Cleansing the Undercity]] | followed by = [[Cleansing Pongmei Valley]]
[[Cleansing the Sunjiang District (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Cleansing the Sunjiang District.jpg|250px]] | map1text = From Zin Ku Corridor }} Clean out the [[Afflicted]] from [[Sunjiang District (explorable area)|Sunjiang District]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Defeat the Afflicted in Sunjiang District. * See [[Initiate Zei Ri]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,000 [[Experience]] *500 [[Gold]] *[[Ministerial Commendation]] ===Environmental changes=== * Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in [[Sunjiang District (Winds of Change)|Sunjiang District]]; specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn. ==Walkthrough== *To complete this quest, your character must have successfully completed the missions: Boreas Seabed, Arborstone, and Sunjiang District, otherwise a gate will block the path to the last group of Afflicted that must be defeated. Start from [[Zin Ku Corridor]] and head south into the [[Sunjiang District (explorable area)|Sunjiang District]]. The Am Fah encountered on the way to the first quest marker do not use Winds of Change builds and so are trivial to defeat. Follow the quest markers and kill off the Afflicted groups. While it might look like an equidistant route to approach this quest from the south, the Am Fah in Pongmei Valley do use the Winds of Change builds and so are much more difficult than the Zin Ku Corridor route. The final group spawns very near the fourth group, namely near the [[Ranger's Construct]] boss. There's a risk of aggro before recuperating from the previous fight; consider pulling the fourth group further away from the tunnel, and then pulling the final group away from the Shiro'ken. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s ([[Ministry of Purity]]) *{{rt}} 28 [[Initiate Zei Ri]] ===Foes=== [[Afflicted]] *{{w}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Warrior]] *{{r}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Ranger]] *{{mo}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Monk]] *{{n}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Necromancer]] *{{me}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Mesmer]] *{{e}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Elementalist]] *{{a}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Assassin]] *{{rt}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Ritualist]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Initiate Zei Ri :''"This is it. The last sighting of Afflicted within [[Kaineng City]]. Until now, you have helped me fight, while [[Ministry of Purity|the Ministry]] has continued the battle on other fronts. It seems that the Afflicted aren't returning. So tell me friend, how does it feel? Knowing that you're making a difference in the world? Well, I guess that's a moot question to be asking you. You must be used to that sort of thing by now!'' :''"The final Afflicted were seen in '''Sunjiang District'''. Will you help me send those unfortunate souls to [[the Mists]]?"'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = We've come this far. Let's see it through. | decline = Actually, this is far enough. | ask = Kaineng City is almost free. The only place left for us is '''Sunjiang District'''. I'll meet you there. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== After the first encounter :'''Initiate Zei Ri:''' ''"So many lives were lost to the Afflicted. Yet, no matter how large the number, it doesn't have as much impact on me as an individual loss."'' After the second encounter :'''Initiate Zei Ri:''' ''"My father was one of the casualties. There was a time, as a younger man, when I wished nothing more than for him to be gone. Looking back on that now..."'' :'''Initiate Zei Ri:''' ''"He was a strict man, my father. He was impossibly hard on me at times. I always thought he resented me. Too late, I came to understand that was just his way of showing he cared for me."'' After the third encounter :'''Initiate Zei Ri:''' ''"Every time I face the Afflicted, some part of me fears that my father might have become one of these abominations. How would I feel if I knew, I wonder?"'' :''':''' ''"How it ends is the important part. You would know that his soul was at rest."'' :'''Initiate Zei Ri:''' ''"This is what we've been working toward. Let's finish this."'' After the final encounter :'''Initiate Zei Ri:''' ''"It's hard to believe that they're finally gone from Kaineng City. I wonder if we'll receive a commendation from [[Reiko Murakami|Minister Reiko]]."'' :''':''' ''"Is that who's in charge of the Ministry of Purity?"'' :'''Initiate Zei Ri:''' ''"Ah, that's right. You haven't had the chance to meet her yet, but she is indeed in charge. I can't wait to report the good news. Let's get going!"'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Initiate Zei Ri :''"We've done it! It has been a hard-fought battle, but the city is safe now. However, our work isn't done yet: some Afflicted remain on the outskirts of the city, and there is rebuilding to be done. We must see to the injured and to the allies who fell along the way. But we shouldn't let those thoughts taint this moment. This is an important step forward. Take this. I hope that it serves as some compensation to you."'' [[Category:Rewards Ministerial Commendation]]
